required_surface: The user's visible Google Chrome chrome://extensions and toolbar or selected-text invocation surface
required_positive_evidence: The exact package digest is visibly loaded and enabled at chrome://extensions.
A toolbar or selected-text gesture grants temporary activeTab access to the visible synthetic source.
The exact reviewed asset is visible before Submit.
A user-visible network trace shows no capture POST before Submit.
One explicit Submit creates one account-scoped synthetic localhost receipt.
No other tab, history, cookie, live candidate data, or external write is accessed.
adjudication_rule: Automated or downstream localhost evidence cannot substitute for the visible user Google Chrome permission and invocation boundary.
verification: Run TS-CORE-01 once in a policy-authorized user Google Chrome profile with the exact digest and retain a visible chrome://extensions state, toolbar or selected-text gesture, activeTab grant, pre-Submit trace, exact preview, Submit, and matching localhost receipt.
